readmeMarkdown:
# Codex Executor

An **Antigravity** plugin that turns **Antigravity** into the orchestrator (planning, architecture, design, copywriting, and verification) and **Codex CLI** into a strictly guarded, high-cache, minimal-output execution engine via MCP.

> **Antigravity 负责总控（规划、架构、审美、文案与验收） · Codex 负责执行（严格按边界写代码、跑命令与验证）**

---

## Why Codex Executor?

- **Clear division of labor**: Antigravity pre-decides design, copy, and architecture, then dispatches crisp imperative work orders to Codex—eliminating verbose GPT prose and unrequested freelancing.
- **Minimal output overhead**: Enforces `model_reasoning_summary="none"`, `hide_agent_reasoning=true`, zero pre-tool narration, and a 2-field JSON ACK (`{"ok": boolean, "err": string}`). All real file diffs, commands, and exit codes are captured directly by the MCP bridge from JSONL events and Git/filesystem snapshots.
- **Lean prefix & persistent cache lanes**: Disables unused Codex Desktop plugins/UI features on worker runs to cut cold input tokens, and persists workspace cache lanes (`session_mode: "auto"`) keyed by exact prefix signature `(cwd, lane, model, reasoning_effort, sandbox, prompt_hash, schema_hash)` for high prompt-cache reuse across turns.
- **Engine-level runtime guardrails**:
  - **Destructive command blocker**: Real-time JSONL watchdog kills processes attempting unauthorized `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f`, `git push --force`, root deletes, sensitive dotfile edits, or remote pipe execution.
  - **File-scope cage (`allowed_paths` / `forbidden_paths`)**: Real-time and post-run verification of all touched files, with automatic revert (`auto_revert_violations`) of unauthorized edits in Git repositories while preserving valid in-scope changes.
  - **Runaway loop breaker**: Enforces `max_commands` and terminates identical failing command loops automatically.
- **Parallel batch dispatch (`codex_batch_exec`)**: Runs up to 4 concurrent Codex workers on separate cache lanes with upfront disjoint-path validation and sibling Git delta isolation.
- **Zero npm dependencies**: Pure Node.js ESM (`>=18`), instant startup, automatic Codex binary discovery (`CODEX_BIN`, `PATH`, and Windows Store `OpenAI.Codex` MSIX packages).

---

## Architecture

```text
Antigravity (Orchestrator: Plan · Design · Audit · User Chat)
   │
   │  MCP (Stdio JSON-RPC 2.0) — codex-worker
   ▼
codex-executor/server/
   ├── Runtime Guardrails (Command Watchdog · Scope Cage · Auto-Revert · Loop Breaker)
   ├── Persistent Cache Lanes (lanes.json · Rollout Telemetry · Auto-Rotation)
   └── Parallel Batch Scheduler (codex_batch_exec · Disjoint Path Check)
   │
   │  codex exec / codex exec resume (--json, --output-schema, lean flags)
   ▼
Local Codex CLI (default: gpt-6.2-sol, reasoning_effort=max)
```

---

## Prerequisites

1. **Antigravity** (2.0 / IDE / CLI)
2. **Node.js `>= 18`** available in `PATH`
3. **Codex CLI** or **Codex Desktop** installed and configured (authentication/provider configured in `~/.codex/config.toml`)

---

## Installation

Clone this repository directly into your global Antigravity plugins directory:

### Windows (PowerShell)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/WSDyi/codex-executor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\codex-executor"
```

### macOS / Linux

```bash
git clone https://github.com/WSDyi/codex-executor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/codex-executor
```

Antigravity automatically discovers plugins placed under `~/.gemini/config/plugins/<name>/` (with `plugin.json`), loads `rules/AGENTS.md`, `skills/codex-orchestrator/SKILL.md`, and starts the `codex-worker` MCP server without requiring a manual build step.

---

## Configuration

Defaults are configured in `mcp_config.json` under `mcpServers.codex-worker.env` and can be adjusted at any time:

| Environment Variable | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CODEX_DEFAULT_MODEL` | `gpt-6.2-sol` | Default Codex model slug |
| `CODEX_DEFAULT_REASONING_EFFORT` | `max` | Default reasoning effort (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`) |
| `CODEX_AUTO_ROTATE_TOKENS` | `175000` | Soft context token threshold before rotating a hot lane to a fresh thread |
| `CODEX_LANE_IDLE_MINUTES` | `45` | Idle expiration window for cached workspace lanes |
| `CODEX_DEFAULT_MAX_COMMANDS` | `80` | Default per-job shell command ceiling |
| `CODEX_BIN` | *(auto-discovered)* | Optional explicit path to the `codex` executable |

---

## MCP Tools (`codex-worker`)

| Tool | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- |
| `codex_exec` | Execute a guarded Work Order on a workspace cache lane (supports `allowed_paths`, `forbidden_paths`, `strict_guard`, `auto_revert_violations`, `profile`, `lane`, `session_mode`, and `async`) |
| `codex_batch_exec` | Dispatch multiple independent Work Orders in parallel on separate cache lanes with upfront disjoint `allowed_paths` validation |
| `codex_resume` | Send a follow-up or fix directive to an existing `thread_id` while preserving identical cache flags and guardrails |
| `codex_job_status` | Inspect live command progress, `guard_audit`, `observed_evidence`, and `cache_metrics` (supports `wait_sec` long-polling) |
| `codex_job_cancel` | Immediately terminate a running Codex worker process tree |
| `codex_cache_manage` | List (`status`), reset (`reset`), or prune (`prune`) persistent workspace cache lanes |
| `codex_health` | Check Codex binary discovery, CLI version, model catalog status, guardrail defaults, and active cache lanes |

---

## Testing

Run the end-to-end integration test suite (unit guardrail tests + MCP handshake + live parallel batch & hot cache-lane reuse):

```bash
npm test
# or
node server/test-mcp.mjs
```

---

## Repository Layout

```text
codex-executor/
├── plugin.json                         # Antigravity plugin manifest
├── mcp_config.json                     # Stdio MCP server definition
├── package.json                        # Zero-dependency ESM metadata & scripts
├── assets/logo.svg                     # Plugin icon
├── rules/AGENTS.md                     # Always-on orchestration rules
├── skills/codex-orchestrator/SKILL.md  # Orchestration playbook
├── prompts/
│   ├── codex-worker.md                 # Minimal silent worker instructions
│   └── worker-output-schema.json       # 2-field JSON ACK schema ({"ok","err"})
└── server/
    ├── index.mjs                       # Zero-dependency MCP stdio server
    ├── codex-runner.mjs                # Runner, runtime guardrails, cache lanes, batch scheduler
    └── test-mcp.mjs                    # Unit & live integration test suite
```

---

## License

Initial public release of **Codex Executor** for Antigravity.

### Highlights
- **Clear Role Boundary**: Antigravity handles planning, architecture, design, copywriting, and verification; Codex CLI executes scoped engineering work via MCP (codex-worker).
- **Minimal Output & Lean Prefix**: Enforces model_reasoning_summary="none", hide_agent_reasoning=true, a 2-field {"ok","err"} JSON ACK, and disables unused Codex Desktop plugins/skills on worker runs.
- **Persistent Workspace Cache Lanes**: Automatically reuses warm Codex threads per (cwd, lane, model, reasoning_effort, sandbox) with rollout-based token metrics and soft context rotation.
- **Engine-Level Runtime Guardrails**: Real-time destructive command blocking, llowed_paths/ orbidden_paths scope verification with automatic revert in Git repos, and runaway command/loop circuit breaking.
- **Parallel Batch Execution**: codex_batch_exec runs up to 4 concurrent Codex workers on separate lanes with upfront disjoint-path validation and sibling Git delta isolation.
